description.value:
Frequency once per hour

Cost 3 Vitae

Duration 1 minute

You may have two self-mutation effects active at the same time that would normally be exclusive, including two full monstrous forms. For the duration you take a −1 circumstance penalty to all saving throws, because parts of you are arguing.

cinderfall.incomplete: This card's entire payload is a Vitae-spend/gain beyond the bare pool, a Bloom Table roll/choice, Resonance, Load, Strain, or "Mk" grade -- none of which has any rule-element representation anywhere in this corpus. fleshmancer.vitae-pool.json's own SpecialResource (slug: vitae, max: 10, renew: false) only declares the bare pool; its schema (value, max, itemUUID, level, renew) has no field for a per-source gain/spend/reroll/choose trigger, so every Vitae-cost/-gain clause on every other card is inert as far as system.rules is concerned, and Bloom/Resonance/Load/Strain have no representation at all. Stacking two normally-exclusive self-mutation effects depends on an unmodeled "self-mutation effect" framework that doesn't exist as a rule-element concept anywhere in this corpus.
